'''Chid''' was the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury cruiser]] ''[[Tinta Rainbow]]''. He taught [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] about the art of cuisine during his stay aboard.
